name: 20 deg dovetail cutter
description: 30 mm HSS dovetail cutter, 20 degrees per side (40 included), widest at the tip: undercuts the end notches' walls.

key_specs.name: Flank angle
key_specs.note: per side, from the axis; 40 deg included

license: self-made parametric generator (moonshot.library.generators, family dovetail), sized from the part it cuts (ll-1005337's STEP and drawing); no maker's tool
notes: ll-1005337's two end notches' undercut walls and their R15 corners (Op 10 undercut). Model generated by moonshot.library.generators (family dovetail) from the wall it cuts, not a catalogue's 10 or 20 deg naming. The angle as read from ll-1005337's STEP (part.step, 2026-11-05): each end notch's undercut wall is a plane whose normal is (0, -/+0.9397, -0.3420), 20.000 deg from vertical, leaning 6.93 mm over the 19.05 mm plate (Y 24.62 at the top face, 31.55 at the bottom), and its R15 corners are cylinders whose axes lean the same 20 deg; the drawing (314-092-59986-10, section A-A) dimensions it 20 deg and 24.6, and the plan's op10 undercut 'walls 20 deg'. So the flank is 20 deg per side, 40 deg included, widest at the tip. Sized to the notch: 30 mm at its widest, twice the R15 corners, the largest that doesn't leave them (a cutter makes no corner tighter than its radius), and 20 mm of cut over the 19.05 mm wall; the 12 mm neck 5 mm long, the 3/4 in shank (for the shop's 3/4 in CAT40 end mill holder), 70 mm overall, 6 straight flutes and HSS [proposed]. A vertical cutter's corners are its cone, R15 at the wall's foot narrowing to R8.1 at the top face, where the model's leaning R15 stays R15 all the way up (the drawing doesn't dimension R15).
